description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Muththettupita, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District (25/0309)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and encumbrances - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category definition.
